name: Summer Scent
source:
It's the beginning of summer. Jack is 18 years old and has just finished high school by graduating.
He has a tense relationship with Eve, his sister who seems to have disliked him cordially for a few years.
Jack's parents having left town for a week, Eve invites her best friend, Cassie, to join them.
They have the house and the pool for them alone.
How Jack will handle the situation depends on you.

(Names can be changed)

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/TheNaughtyCaptain]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
夏天刚刚开始。杰克18岁，刚刚高中毕业。
他与姐妹伊芙关系紧张，几年来，她似乎一直对他颇为反感。
父母要离城一周，伊芙便邀请最好的朋友卡茜来和他们一起住。
整栋房子和泳池都归他们独享。
杰克将如何应对这一局面，由你决定。

（姓名可以更改）
